in_marathi.name: Dheeksah
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheeksah हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheeksah is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘dheeksha’, which means ‘receiving’. The name is associated with the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi, and represents the act of receiving blessings and prosperity. The name is often given to girls to bless them with abundance and good fortune.
